types.description: TeSys D 3-pole contactor, 230 V AC 50/60 Hz coil, factory 1 NO + 1 NC auxiliary contacts

document.title: TeSys contactors — Model d, historical Schneider Electric / Telemecanique extract

modelingNotes: Historical selection explicitly supports LC1-D40P7. Modern exact datasheet spells LC1D40P7; LC1D40AP7 is a distinct replacement, excluded.

Exact product ratings: Schneider Electric LC1D40P7 datasheet, October 10, 2023, pp. 1–2, manufacturer-authored distributor mirror: https://files.kempstoncontrols.com/files/6910a94da3ba87d916791800fa6adff8/LC1D40P7.pdf

Main capability: 40 A AC-3 at <=440 V and ambient <60 deg C; 60 A AC-1 at the same conditions; 18.5 kW at 380–400 V AC 50 Hz AC-3. No unconditional main-current or nominal-main-voltage scalar asserted.
P7 coil: 230 V AC, 50/60 Hz; no built-in bidirectional peak limiting diode suppressor according to exact datasheet. No accessory suppressor modeled. No polarity assigned.
Terminal keys preserve S1 diagram labels exactly, including T1/2, T2/4, T3/6, 13/NO and 21/NC; no phase or physical orientation inference.

A1 and A2 are required for electrical operation. Main and auxiliary contact usage is application-dependent. Coil and contact functions and mechanical actuation relations never join nets; no fixed links are asserted.

All documented circuit functions are modeled. Physical duplicated coil access and exhaustive clamp inventory are unverified. Optional add-on contact blocks, suppressors and enclosing-panel bonding are outside this selected-order model.

connectionCoverage.notes: All 12 endpoints of the applicable historical 3-pole LC1-D09 to D150 diagram are included. Exact physical clamping/access-point inventory, especially possible duplicated coil access, is not established; no duplicate endpoints or internal links invented. No PE/shield/communication endpoint is documented for the selected circuit.
